Maya (Docs): Quick check — PR #4621 updates the structured-output guide for tool-calling. I left an edge-case about nullable outputs.

Leo (Eng-ML): saw it, nice. Which example are you leaning to keep? the "order" or the "inventory" one?

Maya (Docs): prefer "inventory" bc it's simpler. But the schema currently forces "items" array non-null; ML wants a graceful fallback when model says "no items".

Tariq (SDK): we should show both: strict schema + relaxed nullable shim. I'll add tiny JS/Python snippets. Example for nullable schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "items": {"type": ["array", "null"], "items": {"type": "string"}},
    "confidence": {"type": "number"}
  },
  "required": ["confidence"]
}
```

Nina (Docs): can you also add a parse-fallback pattern? e.g., attempt JSON.parse, if fails, run a regex for key tokens and wrap into the same shape. Keep snippet < 12 lines.

Tariq (SDK): yup. I'll push a small helper in the SDK snippets:

- python: try json.loads(resp); except: wrap with {"items": null, "confidence": 0.0}
- js: same pattern, mention async streaming caveat

Maya (Docs): also found a broken link on the live page to the function-calling primer — https://docs.redwood.ai/tool-calling -> 404. Nina can you file the link-fix PR?

Nina (Docs): on it. Will target the same docs PR so CI sees final render. tagging @ci-bot for preview

ci-bot: Preview build queued for PR #4621 — checks: lint, build, linkcheck. ETA ~6m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Leo (Eng-ML): small nit: in the runtime note mention we prefer prefix-caching for tool-calling heavy workloads; saves tokens when assistant repeats context.

Maya (Docs): good catch. Add a 1-sentence note and a short benchmark link.

Tariq (SDK): once I push snippets, can someone else review SDK examples? I'll ping @Maya and @Leo for quick eyes. I want to avoid breaking examples across versions.

Maya (Docs): I'll review tonight. If green CI and link fix landed, I'll merge and then follow up with a tiny commit to add the regex fallback example.

Nina (Docs): merging plan is fine. I'll do the link PR now and add a comment on the PR with the preview URL when CI is done.

Maya (Docs): thanks — plan: Tariq pushes snippets (js + py), Nina fixes link and merges, I land follow-up fallback commit. Everyone ok?

Leo (Eng-ML): :thumbsup:

Tariq (SDK): 👍 will open the snippet PR shortly (branch: sdk/toolcall-fallbacks)

ci-bot: Build passed for PR #4621 — lint OK, build OK, linkcheck failed: /tool-calling -> 404

Nina (Docs): link PR opened: #4626. fixes /tool-calling -> /function-calling (canonical). Also updated sidebar anchor.

Maya (Docs): perfect. I'll hold on merge until #4626 lands.

Tariq (SDK): PR #4627 created with SDK snippets. includes both strict + nullable examples and parsing helper.

Leo (Eng-ML): quick pass done. left one comment about the confidence default in fallback (use 0.01 not 0.0 to avoid downstream division by zero). tiny change.

Tariq (SDK): fixed.

ci-bot: All PRs passed: #4621, #4626, #4627. Merge queue processed.

Maya (Docs): merged. Follow-up created for regex fallback polish: #4630. Thanks all!
